summary.scope: Single-slot source-only own rollouts; inputs unchanged, actual pools only. View adequacy reviewed separately in before/after source contexts. No silent stale-view credit or future-source reconstruction.

diagnostic.scope: New offline preferences on actual BASE prefixes, not a task quality score. Choices are scored after label construction, never copied into targets.

interpretation: 171 real BASE prefixes remain dev-only. Preference matching124/171 is not QA error rate. Fifteen actual READ choices occurred after reviewed original sufficiency, but no causal claim of answer damage is made. Old T0 collection/labels unchanged.
mechanism: Read each request's actually persisted evidence pool from a diagnostic Store copy, preserve actual observations, map original-source spans to offline proof sets; no final-state reconstruction or teacher-choice copying.
view_review: Opened query views are judged separately for actual before/after source context. Missing review masks the state unless original Sources independently suffice. Stale view review is not inferred from successful USE or schema acceptance.
